about: The Katana's high deflect at a limb (milestone-1 task 90), made in Cascadeur: the parrier's half when a blade parries a fist or a foot meeting it from 1.3 m up (the owner, Oct 8: every punch and the high kicks, which meet at 1.35-1.63 m), played from its contact frame (2), cut in from the guard. Parry1H01's right hit at its own speed, made two-handed as the lights' deflects are (task 34) and aimed at the moment of contact so the blade meets the Jab's fist on the Jab's contact frame, at bare hands' duelling distance less the Jab's travel to it (1.55 m), knocking the fist away. Cascadeur's AI inbetweening generates every frame but the key poses. Picture only. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
